title: Balance Sheet Audit Trail
summary: Upload a workbook with SOFP, Trial Balance and General Ledger sheets and get an automated audit trail: every Balance Sheet line is traced to its Trial Balance accounts and General Ledger transactions, reconciled against the reported figure, with differences and missing mappings clearly flagged.
prompt: Create a generic Balance Sheet Audit Support feature that accepts an uploaded Excel workbook (following the same structure as the provided sample workbook) as input. The workbook will contain at least three sheets: "SOFP", "TB New 2025", and "GL New 2025" (or equivalent configurable sheet names). The feature should automatically read the workbook, identify the Statement of Financial Position (SOFP), Trial Balance (TB), and General Ledger (GL) data, and generate an end-to-end audit trail for every Balance Sheet head. For each SOFP closing balance, identify the relevant TB and GL account(s), derive the closing balance from the underlying GL data, present a detailed breakup showing how the reported balance is composed, reconcile the aggregated GL balance with the reported SOFP balance, and clearly flag any differences, missing mappings, or unreconciled amounts. The output should be a structured audit report that enables Finance and Audit teams to trace every reported Balance Sheet figure back to its supporting ledger accounts and transactions without manually reviewing the entire General Ledger. The implementation should work for any uploaded workbook that follows the same tabular structure as the sample, rather than being hardcoded to a specific file.
assumptions: The SOFP sheet has a row with 4-digit year labels; the most recent year's column is treated as the reported closing balance
The TB sheet has Debit/Credit column pairs (or a single Closing Balance column); if multiple pairs exist, the one labelled End/Closing (else the rightmost pair) is used
The GL sheet lists one block per account: an account-name row followed by dated transaction rows (with an optional Initial Balance row) until the next account or a 'Total for' row

Automatic matching of TB/GL accounts to SOFP lines is a best-effort suggestion based on name similarity and generic accounting terminology; it is meant to be reviewed and adjusted in the UI, not treated as final without review
gaps: Supplementary note sheets referenced via a 'Note' column on the SOFP are not cross-referenced automatically
Formula errors in the source workbook (e.g. #REF!) are flagged rather than guessed at
No persistence: uploaded workbooks and any manual mapping adjustments live only in server memory and are lost on restart
expects: An Excel workbook (.xlsx/.xlsm) with at least three sheets: a Statement of Financial Position (SOFP) with a year header row, a Trial Balance with Debit/Credit or Closing Balance columns, and a General Ledger with one block of dated transactions per account (any sheet names are fine, they're confirmed/selected after upload)
